title: Deleting the Notifications widget to which notifications are bound to makes them appear in top-left corner until plasmashell is restarted, even if there's already another Notifications widget they could appear near
line: After removing the System Tray that notifications appear next to, new notifications now appear next to the remaining System Tray right away.
explanation: Removing a widget first only marks it as deleted, so the removal can still be undone; the applet object stays alive until the Undo notification expires. The Notifications applet only left the list of candidate popup parents in Component.onDestruction, so during that time it was still rated as the best parent although its tray was hidden, and popups (including the Undo notification itself) went to a screen corner. The applet now leaves the list as soon as it is marked as deleted and rejoins it if the removal is undone.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: stop following a widget that is being removed

Popups kept following a removed Notifications widget until its removal
became final, so while it could be undone they went to a screen corner.
Forget the widget when it is marked for deletion, adopt it on undo.

BUG: 482411

Same steps with the fix: the Undo notification appears right under the remaining top-panel tray
